claim_origin: Curator index of existing retained findings; review judgments remain separate. No new discovery claim added.

findings.statement: A causal housing/speed observer is a useful calibrated reference within one gearbox, with long-duration failures.
findings.applicability: Complete runs from one gearbox; external causal forcing plus first lubricanttemperature initialization; startup excluded from score.
findings.limitations: Worst original run 2.728 C; no new gearbox/sensorless claim. Source already describes an observer.
falsification: Perturb future forcing and later lubricant targets to confirm prefix invariance.
Exclude initialization from score and report cooldown, long-term and high-speed separately.
Test stable recurrences, parametergrid sensitivity and prespecified temperature-alarm delay/miss rates only if independent thresholds exist.
findings.prior_art: The source two-state observer has unmatched reported 1.3 KMAE; absent exact code/coefficients prohibit superiority claims. No new thermodynamic law. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

equation_or_program.interpretation: Executable numerical representation only; mechanism/novelty admission is assessed separately. Displayed coefficients can be rounded; exact executable states are authoritative.
